entities.name: Query protein (354 aa)
observations: 354-aa sequence; calculated mass 39.64 kDa and theoretical pI 7.68.
Strong similarity to reviewed quinone-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenases: up to 44.0% identity over 93.8% query coverage (E=3.49e-92).
Homology supports catalysis of (S)-dihydroorotate oxidation to orotate using quinone; expected role in de novo pyrimidine/UMP biosynthesis.
Related reference proteins bind FMN and are peripheral membrane proteins; these attributes are transferred by homology, not directly established for this query.
Pfam DHO_dh domain detected at residues 49–338 (PF01180.28; i-Evalue 3.6e-68).
